tokenizer.reason: embedded in the GGUF weights blob sha256:2bada8a7450677000f678be90653b85d364de7db25eb5ea54136ada5f3933730; no separate tokenizer artifact exists

parser.effective: runtime-side: Ollama renders the model template and returns OpenAI tool_calls

sampling.topP: runtime default (not sent by the client)
sampling.source: LOCAL_LLM_TEMPERATURE / LOCAL_LLM_SEED sent in every /v1/chat/completions request

context.source: configured: LOCAL_LLM_CONTEXT_TOKENS + OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH; runtime: /api/ps context_length of the loaded model

jellyfinLoad.workload: ffmpeg hardware transcode representative of a Jellyfin AMF transcode: d3d11va decode, CPU scale to 1280x720, h264_amf encode at 4 Mb/s, audio dropped
jellyfinLoad.fixture: 1920x1080 30 fps testsrc2, 60 s, libx264 veryfast yuv420p, generated by perf.mjs; sha256 recorded in the evidence
jellyfinLoad.throughputMetric: frames per second of wall time
jellyfinLoad.runDefinition: the 60 s fixture is looped 5 times (9000 frames) so one run lasts several seconds and the inference load overlaps all of it; the load starts first and must have one request in flight before the transcode begins
jellyfinLoad.reason: no Jellyfin server runs in the lab; the transcoder workload is declared instead of a Jellyfin session

deviceSharing.detail: inference (ROCm) and the AMF transcode run on the same Radeon RX 7800 XT
deviceSharing.concurrentInferenceLoad: continuous non-streamed completions, frozen prompt, max_tokens 512, temperature 0, seed 42, until the transcode ends

memoryPolicy.sampler: external PowerShell process, PDH GPU Process Memory\Dedicated Usage and WorkingSet64 summed over every ollama* and llama-server* process (Ollama 0.34 loads the weights in a llama-server worker)
memoryPolicy.admission: OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS=1, OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=1, server admits one inference at a time
memoryPolicy.hardGpuQuota: none: no portable hard VRAM limit exists on this platform; admission and supervision stop new loads instead

privacy.detail: native Windows server and runtime; network containment is verified separately by G09 in the isolated Docker topology
